# Sellf

> Sellf is a self-hostable platform for selling digital products, built on Next.js, Supabase and Stripe. These are the documentation pages, for agents and tools. Polish versions live under https://docs.sellf.app/pl/.

## Selling licenses for an application

- [License integration contract](https://docs.sellf.app/llms/license-integration.md): token format, claims, public-key and revocation endpoints, verification algorithm, license webhooks, seller API
- [Sell licenses for your app](https://docs.sellf.app/license-integration/): setup in the panel, key delivery, verification code (TypeScript, PHP, Python), agent prompt

## API and integrations

- [REST API v1](https://docs.sellf.app/api/): endpoints, API keys and scopes, pagination
- [Connect your AI agent](https://docs.sellf.app/connect-ai-agent/): MCP server setup with scoped keys
- [Webhooks](https://docs.sellf.app/webhooks/): envelope, signature verification, retries, event payloads
- [Buyer emails](https://docs.sellf.app/buyer-emails/): delivering buyer messages through webhooks or Supabase
- [PlayerStack lead forms](https://docs.sellf.app/playerstack-leads/): email-confirmed lead magnets
- [Purchase sources](https://docs.sellf.app/purchase-attribution/): UTM and referrer attribution in the API and webhooks
